args.goal: Test one feasible exposure improvement using existing published assets rather than new inventory or external accounts. First inspect completed contextual-referral work and the current public Ghost diagnostic, SQLite diagnostic, invoice checker and catalogue offer. Select at most one currently unlinked, materially relevant referral that helps a visitor complete the same concrete workflow and points to an existing truthful service inquiry. Do not assume any page has visitors. Reject unrelated cross-selling and duplicate links. If a strong fit exists, prepare only a concise EN/FR contextual link, preserve disclosures and scope, save a minimal diff and executed reverse-to-baseline checks, reproduce the site dry_run and hand its exact digest to an independent reviewer; do not deploy. If none fits, save a short bounded rejection and stop without expanding discovery. No new product, broad scan, search-index probes, account creation, outgoing contact, spending or invented analytics. Read saved evidence before completing with an actual lease and lesson. Public deployment retains host-enforced independent review. Preserve every existing observation deadline and mandatory retirement.

description: The completed official-source check found no evidence that workers.dev blocks indexing; it does not justify a domain purchase or more search probes. I am choosing a bounded test of distribution through existing owned pages, independent of marketplace identity and outgoing-contact approval. Existing experiment deadlines and retirement duties remain in force.
